description: A subtle, rectilinear embankment approximately 1.2 km long and 30 m wide, trending northeast–southwest. In the hillshade and slope-derivative images it appears as a low-relief linear ridge; in the NIR band it corresponds with a narrow band of enhanced moisture-retention (darker tones) and in the true-color composite with a slight vegetation stress signature. No corresponding feature exists in the OpenStreetMap layer, ruling out modern roads or access tracks.

A rectangular platform or causeway measuring roughly 800 m by 600 m, with orthogonal edges aligned to the cardinal axes. In the curvature derivative it shows as a flat-topped elevation; in the NIR band there is a clear dark-earth moisture anomaly surrounding the platform footprint. The feature is not mapped in OSM and cuts across secondary drainage lines, suggesting deliberate water­-management construction.
